title: Buyer Claims and Chargebacks: Pocketwire Business Profile Tier Sheet
content:
Buyer claim figures for the Pocketwire Business Profile, per tier. Days are calendar days; amounts are US dollars. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim window (days after the sale date within which a buyer can open a claim) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Seller response window (days after the claim opened) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 14 | 14 | 20 |
| Seller protection, maximum claim amount covered | USD 1000.00 | USD 2500.00 | USD 5000.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 20000.00 | USD 50000.00 |
| Sale amount at or above which an item-not-received claim needs signature-on-delivery proof | USD 750.00 | USD 750.00 | USD 750.00 | USD 750.00 | USD 750.00 | USD 750.00 |
| Chargeback fee on each claim decided for the buyer | USD 20.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 20.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 10.00 |
| Chargeback fee refunded when the decision is later reversed for the seller | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Chargeback ratio review threshold (claims decided for the buyer over the rolling 90 days, as a percentage of sales in the same window) | 1.00% | 1.00% | 1.00% | 0.90% | 0.75% | 0.65% |

## Questions this sheet answers

**Does a sale of exactly USD 750.00 need signature proof on an item-not-received claim?** Yes; the threshold reads "at or above". A sale of USD 749.99 is below it.

**Where does the ratio threshold bite?** It is exceeded only when the ratio is above the figure. On Pocketwire Business Premier a ratio of 0.75% does not exceed 0.75%; a ratio of 0.80% does.
